cases.purpose: On a loop-backed ext2 file fincore reports cold (0 resident pages after sync and drop_caches), exactly one resident page after a single POSIX_FADV_RANDOM read, fully warm after a full read, and cold again, matching util-linux fincore in every state.
cases.oracle: util-linux fincore on the same file in the same page-cache state (mincore/cachestat as root), states produced by posix_fadvise/pread from Python and drop_caches.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and file tree.

files.fc.py:
import os, sys
op, path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
PAGE = os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE")
if op == "make":
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o644)
    os.write(fd, bytes((i * 7) % 251 for i in range(PAGE * 16))); os.fsync(fd); os.close(fd)
elif op == "cold":
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY); os.fsync(fd) if False else None
    os.posix_fadvise(fd, 0, 0, os.POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED); os.close(fd)
elif op == "one":
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY); os.posix_fadvise(fd, 0, 0, os.POSIX_FADV_RANDOM)
    os.pread(fd, 1, PAGE * 5); os.close(fd)
elif op == "warm":
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY)
    while os.read(fd, 65536): pass
    os.close(fd)

cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >o.txt 2>e.txt; local rc=$?; printf '[%s] status=%s\n' "$l" $rc; norm o.txt; echo "[stderr]"; norm e.txt; }
F() { /usr/bin/python3 fc.py "$@"; }
/usr/bin/truncate -s 6M a.img; $MK -q -t ext2 a.img; at a.img; A=$REPLY; reg $A LOOP-A
/usr/bin/mkdir -p mnt; /usr/bin/mount $A mnt
F make mnt/f; /usr/bin/sync; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches
F cold mnt/f; r cold fincore mnt/f
r cold-bytes fincore -b mnt/f
F one mnt/f; r one-page fincore -b mnt/f
F warm mnt/f; r warm fincore -b mnt/f
r warm-human fincore mnt/f
F cold mnt/f; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches; r cold-again fincore -b mnt/f
